label: Education
assignment: Discover realistic education resources for people in {service_area} who need literacy, language learning, a high-school equivalency, postsecondary education, trades, credentials, scholarships, or accessible learning. Follow institutions to specific programs and funding pathways, verifying prerequisites, cost, aid, schedules, format, accommodations, and enrollment deadlines.
include: Adult literacy, English-language learning, tutoring, and digital literacy
GED or high-school completion and adult education
College, career, trade, apprenticeship, credential, and continuing-education pathways
Scholarships, grants, tuition assistance, advising, testing, and application help
Evening, online, disability-accessible, multilingual, reentry, and other barrier-aware options
exclude: General school or college homepages without a specific accessible program or enrollment path
Commercial courses with unclear accreditation, cost, completion, or employment value
Expired scholarships or enrollment opportunities presented as currently available
verificationQuestions: What prerequisite, placement test, residency, age, or documentation requirement applies?
What is the complete cost after fees, materials, and available aid?
When, where, and in what format are classes offered?
What credential or outcome results, and how does enrollment begin?

stages.title: Foundational and adult learning
stages.instruction: Investigate literacy, English-language, digital-skills, GED, high-school completion, tutoring, and adult-education programs. Verify testing, cost, schedule, format, childcare, and enrollment.

stages.title: Career, trade, and postsecondary pathways
stages.instruction: Investigate college access, trades, apprenticeships, short credentials, career programs, bridge courses, and transfer routes, including prerequisites, accreditation, time, cost, and employment relevance.

stages.title: Aid and barrier-aware access
stages.instruction: Investigate scholarships, grants, tuition help, advising, application assistance, accommodations, language access, evening and online study, and options for reentry, immigrants, parents, and disabled learners.

stages.title: Deadline and outcome gap review
stages.instruction: Cross-check deadlines, current cohorts, full costs, accreditation, credential value, transportation, technology, childcare, and completion supports. Identify populations and schedules poorly served.
